title: The Giant Hornet That Wipes Out a Beehive in Hours

scenes.text: One hornet species can wipe out a whole beehive in hours.
The Asian giant hornet is the largest hornet in the world, at about two inches long.
Its stinger is nearly a quarter inch long.
It attacks honeybee hives in mass raids and kills the bees by removing their heads.
Then the hornets take over the hive and feed the bees to their young.
Hours later, the hive is silent, and the headless bees are all that's left.

description:
One hornet species can wipe out a whole beehive in a matter of hours.
The Asian giant hornet is about two inches long, with a nearly quarter-inch stinger, and it kills bees by removing their heads.
Would you go near one?
first_comment: Would you rather face one giant hornet or a hundred honeybees?
